title: A customer still holding a switched-off rep keeps them and saves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Staff members {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B} are active at {Location-A}. {Sales-rep-B}'s "Sales Representative" switch is on; {Sales-rep-A}'s was on and has since been turned off (the staff account is still active).
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, picked while their switch was on, and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  2. Open Edit Customer.
  3. Click the "Sales Representative - Service Labor" field.
  4. Close the dropdown without picking anything.
  5. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Service Labor still shows {Sales-rep-A}, reading "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)".
  • Step 2: the Edit Customer window opens.
  • Step 3: the field reads "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)"; {Sales-rep-A} is not offered in the dropdown and no option is checked.
  • Step 4: the field still reads "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)".
  • Step 5: the customer saves with no error message, and its page still shows Service Labor "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)" and Service Parts {Sales-rep-B}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today. In Edit Customer and on the customer page their name reads followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)", as on the work order (S1-E2). They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 14: “14. (b) "Name (Inactive)", as on a work order. Yes, no option is ticked while they hold the field.”

  • Tech plan, Phase 2 functional tests (section 3.7, already held): “An already-held unflagged id saves (S4-N2).”
